svg.title: BankSim history capture effects and exchanges
svg.desc: Three left heatmaps show frozen newly captured, lost and net fraud counts for two models and H0/H1; right plots show six original paired effects and a magnified repeat of H1. Captured-fraud counts are not cost or monetary units. Heatmap colours are descriptive; observed arithmetic is not uncertainty.
svg.text: BankSim history capture effects and exchanges
Exact 3% completed-window budget (K = 5,950) · five-seed paired means
G and L have no separate intervals.
